name: Woolloomooloo: Palmer St and Sir John Young Cres beside the motorways' cuttings, moved apart (the levels round them are woolloomooloo.json's)

move.why: Palmer St beside the Eastern Distributor's cutting, from William St's exit to Sir John Young Cres: OSM draws it 2.6-2.8 m east of its kerbs in NSW's aerial, its carriageway 2.2-3.2 m into the motorway's, which is up to 5 m lower (overlaps: 4.1 m at (977, -243)). Moved west 2.3-2.8 m, to its kerbs, 2 m at its junction with Sir John Young Cres

The Eastern Distributor northbound coming up out of its tunnel beside Palmer St: OSM draws it 1-1.5 m west of its lanes in NSW's aerial. Moved east 0.6 m along its middle, its first 30 m, its portal and its junction at Sir John Young Cres kept, so Palmer St (above) is a wall from it and William St's exit on its other side isn't crowded

The Macquarie St off-ramp from its portal under the Domain west to where Sir John Young Cres leaves it, beside Sir John Young Cres's own ramp to its tunnel: OSM draws them 4.1-4.4 m apart, each 5 m wide, 1.9 m apart in height where their tunnels part (overlaps: 2.0 m at (825, -754)). Moved 2.1 m south-west, away from it, into the Domain's bank; the Cahill's lanes are on the ramp's other side, at its height

The Macquarie St off-ramp from where Sir John Young Cres leaves it back to the Cahill Expressway, beside Sir John Young Cres's ramp: moved 2.1 m south-west with the stretch east of it (above), back onto OSM's line where the two come together at one height

Sir John Young Cres from Palmer St to the Cahill Expressway's off-ramp's portal, beside the off-ramp climbing out of its cutting: OSM draws them 5.8-7.1 m apart where the street is 9.1 m wide and the ramp 5 m, up to 3.9 m apart in height (overlaps: 3.9 m at (918, -400)). Moved east up to 2.2 m, away from the ramp
The Cahill Expressway's off-ramp out of its cutting beside Sir John Young Cres: moved 0.4 m west, the room there is to Sir John Young Cres's other carriageway, so the street (above) moves less
